body.statement: Let \(X_1,\ldots,X_n\) be identically distributed independent centered random vectors in \(\mathbb R^d\) with identity covariance, put \(\beta=E\lVert X_1\rVert^3\), and let \(S_n=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^nX_i\). Then the supremum, over convex Borel sets, of the absolute difference between the law of \(S_n\) and the standard Gaussian law is at most \(400d^{1/4}\beta/\sqrt n\).

attestation.note: Specialized from Bentkus's convex-set multivariate Berry--Esseen theorem; stable DOI supplied in place of a verbatim transcription.
